items.headline: Fall arrives with fair air and twenty degrees.
items.lede: Temperatures span 13–20°C under partly cloudy skies.
items.body: The afternoon settles near 20°C while mornings drop briskly to 13°C under calm, partly cloudy skies. Air quality remains fair with PM2.5 readings holding at 9. Sunset arrives precisely at 18:15, drawing long shadows across stone courtyards. Financial exchanges trade at 1 USD to 1355 KRW. It is a quiet week for walking before the coming holiday closures.

items.headline: Parks post warnings as residents gather fallen acorns.
items.lede: Municipal notices remind collectors of fines reaching 50,000-Won.
items.body: Acorn pickers return to city parks this week, bending low beneath oak branches. Municipal signs remind visitors that harvesting tree seeds is restricted, carrying steep fines up to 50,000-Won to protect local wildlife food sources. Elsewhere, the city library celebrates the season with autumn poetry programs. Friedrich Kunath opens 《The Nearest Faraway Place》 at Pace Seoul, exploring longing and distance through art.

items.headline: Government offices close Monday for National Foundation Day.
items.lede: Plan administrative errands before the upcoming Monday holiday.
items.body: South Korea observes National Foundation Day, known as 개천절, on Monday, 2026-10-05. Banks, government offices, and post offices remain shuttered for the day. Travelers should settle administrative tasks early in the week. A second autumn holiday, 한글날, follows soon on 2026-10-09. Meanwhile, Series by Marriott debuts locally with the opening of Anook Signature Seoul Guro.

items.headline: Light drizzle marks a mild autumn afternoon.
items.body: Daytime highs touch 27°C while evening lows settle near 18°C. A trace of light drizzle measuring 0.1mm dampens asphalt before sunset at 17:25. Air quality stays at moderate levels with PM2.5 at 17. Currency exchange holds steady at 1 USD to 157 JPY. The soft moisture brings out the scent of damp earth in quiet neighborhood gardens.

items.headline: Cultural calendars fill with film honors and fashion debuts.
items.lede: The Tokyo Film Festival announces major honorees.
items.body: The Tokyo Film Festival announces that Mohammad Rasoulof and Mipo O will receive the prestigious Kurosawa Akira Award. In fashion and retail, Ralph Lauren prepares to launch PoloFest in October, while HUMAN MADE TOKYO opens its first flagship store featuring lion-emblazoned exclusives. These cultural events bring quiet animation to the city streets. Observers note the seasonal transition in neighborhood styling.

items.headline: Residents note Monday closures for Sports Day next week.
items.lede: Public offices observe スポーツの日 on 2026-10-12.
items.body: As autumn deepens, residents prepare for the upcoming national holiday of スポーツの日 on Monday, 2026-10-12. Government offices, banks, and postal counters will close for the observance. Public spaces and parks will host community athletic events. Travelers should complete essential financial transactions ahead of the weekend closure. Transit networks will operate on holiday schedules.

items.headline: Overcast skies frame the Tagus river at dusk.
items.lede: Temperatures range from 17°C to 23°C in soft light.
items.body: The Tagus river reflects a heavy, overcast canopy as temperatures span 17–23°C. Sunset occurs at 19:19, casting diffused gray light over limestone pavements. Air quality is exceptionally fair with PM2.5 at 5. Currency exchange trades at 1 USD to 0.88 EUR. The steady cloud cover keeps the midday heat gentle for walking through old quarters.

items.headline: Exhibitions celebrate library history and brick models.
items.lede: Europe's largest Lego exhibition opens alongside centennial library events.
items.body: Legomania opens in Lisbon, establishing Europe's largest exhibition of Lego brick models in Portugal. Simultaneously, the Lisbon Public Library hosts events marking its 100th anniversary through the LAHS association. Visitors find indoor spaces lively with cultural programming. These exhibitions offer quiet refuge from the damp river breezes.

items.headline: Monday brings Republic Day closures across the city.
items.lede: Banco de Portugal and public offices close for Implantação da República.
items.body: Portugal observes Implantação da República on Monday, 2026-10-05. Government offices, banks, and municipal services remain closed for the national holiday. Residents stock up on provisions over the weekend as commercial hours shift. Public transit runs on reduced holiday timetables. The city pauses to mark the historical transition with quiet neighborhood observances.
